statement: Implement linux.uinput with Xbox One-specific, Share-free xpad evdev capabilities and caller-selected per-instance identity first. This can target playable Linux and SDL evdev consumers, but cannot by itself claim wired GIP, Bluetooth HID, wireless pairing, independent impulse motors, battery or audio fidelity. Restrict a future linux.uhid.bluetooth realization to independently verified Bluetooth-capable variants and descriptor/output evidence.

applicability.revision: first proposed Xbox One realization, before USB GIP or Bluetooth UHID
applicability.scope: Implementation proposal derived from xpad and SDL consumer sources; actual virtual input creation, SDL and force-feedback acceptance not run.
